correctness.rationale: For fixed ell>=3, integrating McCormick edge intervals after a_i=1-2|x_i-1/2| gives q_ell(u)=2^-ell K^ell(a,a), K=min(s,t), hence Dirichlet-Neumann eigenseries. The disjoint odd-cycle inequality simplex slices yield d_ell(u)=2^-ell/((ell-1)!)^2∫_(2|u|)^1(s²-4u²)^(ell-1)ds. Bernoulli cosine polynomial conversion shows the lone odd |u|^(2ell-1) terms in q and d cancel, giving exact even p_ell=q-d with degree <=2ell-2. Differentiating central fibers gives b_Q,b_D,b_P and strict b_P<b_Q; central strict maxima and one-dimensional Laplace asymptotics yield ratio rho_ell^k sqrt(bQ/bP)(1+O_ell(1/k)) with Gaussian pinned fluctuations. Independent exact symbolic checks ell=3..7 reconstruct p_3,p_4 and verify cancellations; arbitrary ell follows from cosine series and integration, not finite experiments.
